"""Bind official release identity and deployed short-prefill feature settings."""

import ast
from datetime import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen


MAIN = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/BeliefKV")
ROOT = Path("/home/longhao/experiment/.worktrees/beliefkv-v25-followup-20261011")
ENGINE = MAIN / "third_party/sglang-v0.5.20"
OUTPUT = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v306_prefill_feature_audit_20261013.json"
if OUTPUT.exists():
    raise ValueError("preserve existing feature audit")
fields = (
    "enable_prefill_delayer", "prefill_delayer_max_delay_passes",
    "prefill_delayer_token_usage_low_watermark",
    "prefill_delayer_queue_min_ratio", "prefill_delayer_max_delay_ms",
    "min_free_slots_delay", "enable_mixed_chunk", "prefill_decode_interval",
    "chunked_prefill_size", "max_prefill_tokens", "prefill_max_requests",
    "max_running_requests", "disable_overlap_schedule", "schedule_policy",
    "speculative_algorithm",
)
runs = {
    "predictive_v53": MAIN / "experiments/raw/qwen35_native_predictive_replenished_108plus48_20261013_v53/predictive_h2d",
    "native_v29": MAIN / "experiments/raw/qwen35_native_predictive_replenished_108plus48_20261012_v29/native",
}
values = {}
for name, arm in runs.items():
    log = arm / "server.log"
    with log.open("rb") as stream:
        startup = next(line for line in stream if b"] server_args=" in line)
    args = ast.literal_eval(startup.split(b"] server_args=", 1)[1].decode())
    values[name] = {
        "arm": str(arm), "startup_line_sha256": hashlib.sha256(startup).hexdigest(),
        "settings": {field: args[field] for field in fields},
    }
require_same = tuple(field for field in fields if field != "schedule_policy")
if any(
    values["predictive_v53"]["settings"][field] != values["native_v29"]["settings"][field]
    for field in require_same
):
    raise ValueError("shared prefill settings differ")
sources = (
    "python/sglang/srt/managers/scheduler.py",
    "python/sglang/srt/managers/schedule_policy.py",
    "python/sglang/srt/managers/prefill_delayer.py",
    "python/sglang/srt/managers/min_free_slots_delayer.py",
    "python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/fields/schedule.py",
)
release_url = "https://api.github.com/repos/sgl-project/sglang/releases/latest"
with urlopen(Request(release_url, headers={"User-Agent": "BeliefKV-feature-audit"}), timeout=20) as response:
    release_bytes = response.read()
release = json.loads(release_bytes)
refs = subprocess.check_output([
    "git", "ls-remote", "--symref", "origin", "HEAD",
    "refs/tags/v0.5.20", "refs/tags/v0.5.21",
], cwd=ENGINE, text=True, timeout=30)
busy_path = ROOT / "experiments/reports/v305_v53_busy_600_900_20261013.json"
busy = json.loads(busy_path.read_bytes())
row = {
    "observed_at_local": datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
    "official_latest_release": {
        key: release[key] for key in ("tag_name", "published_at", "draft", "prerelease", "target_commitish")
    },
    "official_release_api": release_url,
    "official_release_response_sha256": hashlib.sha256(release_bytes).hexdigest(),
    "official_refs": refs,
    "engine_base_commit": subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=ENGINE, text=True).strip(),
    "source_sha256": {
        path: hashlib.sha256((ENGINE / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in sources
    },
    "deployed_settings": values,
    "verified_paths": {
        "prefill_adder": "Constructed in _get_new_batch_prefill_raw; candidate additions use add_one_req after init_next_round_input.",
        "beliefkv": "Uses the native adder, with additional causal ordering, reentry inspection and callback work.",
        "prefill_delayer": "Implementation exists; enable_prefill_delayer=False in both actual startup records.",
        "min_free_slots_delay": "None in both; no speculative algorithm auto-enables it for this workload.",
        "mixed_chunk": "False in both; compatibility must be checked before an experiment.",
        "prefill_decode_interval": "0 in both; no extra configured decode passes between prefills.",
    },
    "latest_busy_report": str(busy_path),
    "latest_busy_report_sha256": hashlib.sha256(busy_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "latest_exclusive_control_wall_ms": {
        name: busy["arms"]["predictive_h2d"]["control_profile"]["phases"][name]["self_ms"]
        for name in (
            "admission_plan", "reentry_inspection", "control_drain", "event_apply",
            "join_prepare", "prepare_candidate_publication", "prepare_candidate_maintenance",
        )
    },
    "semantics": [
        "Actual startup values, not CLI defaults inferred from implementation presence.",
        "Both arms lack delayer/mixed settings; that absence alone does not explain their relative deficit.",
        "Native request-slot and FULL/Mamba capacity constraints remain authoritative.",
        "A batching change shared with native requires a common-configuration comparison; old V29 is only a diagnostic reference.",
        "Exclusive phase wall spans are additional control work, not a complete prefill/kernel attribution or subtractable JCT.",
        "This audit changes no live configuration, engine source or running experiment.",
    ],
    "helper_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "helper_utf8_source": Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(row, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")
print(json.dumps({
    "observed_at_local": row["observed_at_local"],
    "official_latest_release": row["official_latest_release"],
    "deployed_settings": {name: item["settings"] for name, item in values.items()},
}, indent=2))
